svg.title: Successful factory transfer sequence
svg.desc: Each transfer waits for navigation, localization and five fresh camera detections, then checks the PLC completion and cycle counter.

g.text: A transfer needs evidence, not delivery alone.
Current goal + AMCL; five fresh marker 10 stamps
Write part code, presence, request; read completion
Clear robot coils; confirm safe result; emit cycle event
Repeat gates at inspection marker 20; UNLOADING
DDS ProtocolEvent feeds the passive observer and payload simulator. Each confirmed cycle animates once.
An identical mission ID replays status. A changed payload is rejected. Neither creates a second action.
